title: Software Development Life Cycle Perspective: A Survey of Benchmarks for Code Large Language Models and Agents

bias_targets.target: Social and Demographic bias (Gender, Race, Income)
bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing benchmarks (e.g., FairCoder, SocialBias-Bench) that evaluate generated code and test cases for societal biases, particularly within sensitive domains like recruitment, education, and healthcare.
Surveying datasets (e.g., Zhang et al.) that evaluate whether CodeLLMs and agents exhibit a preference for recommending or generating code using paid services from specific providers.
